speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: What do you mean you didn't get the job? How could you not get it?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You know, he's British, I'm Indian, ever since Gandhi they haven't liked us very much.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Wait, are you saying that he discriminated against you? Because we should file a complaint.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: That's okay. A complaint has been filed. So, that's it. That was my last hope. I'm going to be deported, sent home in disgrace, exposed to the sardonic barbs of my cousin Sanjay. Or, as you may know him, Dave from AT&T customer service.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I'm really going to miss you.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Will you come visit me in India?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Gee, that's, like, a 17-hour flight. How about I meet you halfway?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Halfway is 600 miles off the coast of Japan.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Gentlemen. Raj, did you get the job with Professor Laughlin? I assumed as much. But never fear. Like the subordinate male protagonist in countless action movies who disappears half way through the second reel, I have returned to save the day.
